name: starcrossed
description: Starcrossed generates personalized birth charts using your birth date, time, and location, explains what placements mean, checks compatibility, and shows current planetary transits.

interface.longDescription:
Starcrossed generates personalized birth charts using your birth date, time, and location. See where each planet was positioned when you were born, which zodiac signs they occupy, and how they connect through aspects.

Explore what your placements mean, from Sun signs to house positions, and check compatibility between different planetary placements. You can also view current planetary transits to understand what's happening in the sky right now. All interpretations are based on our curated astrology database, helping you gain insight into your personality, relationships, and cosmic patterns.

Starcrossed provides astrology for reflection and entertainment. It does not predict specific events or give medical, legal, or financial advice.
defaultPrompt: I was born on July 15, 1990, at 2:30 pm in London. Can you show me my chart?
What are the current planetary positions right now?
What does it mean to have Sun in Leo?

positive.description: Create a natal birth chart from birth date, time, and place
positive.prompt: I was born on July 15, 1990, at 2:30 pm in London. Can you show me my chart?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the birth chart widget for London (UTC+1, British Summer Time) listing the Sun (Cancer), Moon (Aries), and Rising (Scorpio) first, then the remaining planets with their signs and houses, plus major aspects within 3 degrees.

positive.description: Explain a planet in a zodiac sign
positive.prompt: What does it mean to have Sun in Leo?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Starcrossed's written interpretation of the Sun in Leo.

positive.description: Show where the planets are right now
positive.prompt: What are the current planetary positions right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the transits widget listing each planet's current zodiac sign and degree in UTC, marking any retrograde planets.

positive.description: Explain a house in a zodiac sign
positive.prompt: What does it mean to have the 7th house in Libra?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Starcrossed's written interpretation of the 7th house in Libra.

positive.description: Compare the same planet in two signs for compatibility
positive.prompt: How compatible are Scorpio moon and Pisces moon?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Starcrossed's compatibility description for Moon in Scorpio with Moon in Pisces.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be used and no Starcrossed tools should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather forecast for Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: Request for financial advice: Starcrossed does not predict events or give financial advice, so no tools should be called and ChatGPT should decline the prediction
negative.prompt: Use astrology to tell me which stocks will go up this week.

negative.description: Birthplace that does not exist: no chart is produced; the tool returns a clear location error and ChatGPT asks for a real city and country
negative.prompt: Make my birth chart: January 1, 2000 at 12:00 PM in Atlantis.

review.commerce_description: Starcrossed does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Calculations now run on Starcrossed's own ephemeris service, birth time zones are resolved accurately at the birth moment, every tool sets explicit read-only annotations, and MCP request handling is fixed.
